column1: # TITLE: Gene expression profiling of lung cancer cells transfected with scrambled siRNA and siRNA targeting the ETS2 gene

# SUMMARY: ETS2 is a canonical transcriptional factor and member of the ETS family of genes. ETS2 binds to consensus ERE binding sites in a broad spectrum of genes thus affecting many intracellular molecular functions. However
column2: the role of ETS2 in the biology and pathogenesis of lung cancers is still not known. We have found that ETS2 is down-regulated in lung tumors compared to normal lung tissue and the expression of the coding protein of the gene was a significant independent predictor of favorable outcome in NSCLC patients pinpointing to a potential tumor suppressor role for this gene. To better understand its molecular function in NSCLC
column3: we compared and contrasted the transcriptome of lung cancer cells transfected with control siRNA and siRNA targeting ETS2.
